scenes.world: A grand dim stone hall and a busy sea harbour by grey day, crowds of men in robes, hard cross-cuts between quay and hall.

captain.asks: Cut hard between quay and hall, shot against reverse, so the two factions face each other across the edit.
diagnosis: The quay works; the hall is a 1930s city of office steps, presses and posters.
No reverse ever answers a shot: faces from five films never share an eyeline.
Penelope is found once in close; the veiled entry is a silent-film doorway in an iris.

scenes.world: A smoky firelit hut on an upland farm at dusk, the same doorway framing, three men at a rough meal.

captain.asks: Replace figures two at a time in one held doorway, the transformation run backward, ending in a fire-lit meal.
diagnosis: No held doorway; the replacement on twos is impossible with these sources.
Fire and food carry the back half; a tractor and bicycles wreck the front.
Penelope's two shots are found only by swapping to a fire-lit woman.
